_doc: Preseason calendars found by hand, because probing could never have reached them. Every entry here is a page the hunter looked for and missed, and the reason is never the content: presaison.lnb.info and padlet.com are not on the league's own origin, so an origin probe cannot see them; tickets.vtb-league.com is a ticket seller, which sources.json already names as the category that publishes a draw first. A pinned URL is read every run and is NOT put to the looksLikeCalendar test — that gate exists to keep the hunter from adopting junk it found on its own, and a page a human vouched for has already passed a better one. Add a line here whenever you find one. A pin marked browser:true is left to render.mjs: a plain fetch returns an empty shell for it, so the hunter skips it rather than spending a read on 75 characters.
